qa_pairs.question: What component is covered under section 12 32 Governor?
How many different screw sizes are specified for the regulator switch?
qa_pairs.answer: Two different screw sizes: M4 and M5

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M4 and M5 screws for the regulator switch?
qa_pairs.answer: The M5 screws require 2 Nm more torque than M4 screws (4 Nm vs 2 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: Which vehicle types do these torque specifications apply to?
What section of the manual covers Engine Electrical Equipment?
What units are used for the torque specifications on this page?
Are there any special conditions or notes specified for the regulator switch torque values?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the specifications apply to all vehicle types without any special conditions noted
